_comment: Durable memory for the self-improving daily-AI-report loop. Written by meta.sh (the daily meta-agent) and read by run.sh (the report run). Delete this file to reset all learnings. Hand-edits are fine; the meta-agent merges, it does not clobber.

sources._comment: keyed by source name from sources.json. seen=runs where scanned, produced=runs where it contributed a kept item, failed=fetch errors, stale=returned data older than window, empty=scanned-but-nothing. status: active|degraded|disabled. The meta-agent flags degraded after a streak and may disable (never delete) with a reason.

judgment._comment: calibration signals for the ranking/quiet-day logic

suspect_quiet_days.reason: Quiet day (0 items) declared, but the run explicitly did NOT fire Playwright for any of the 10 X.com timelines. Dated vendor/research sources were outside the 24h window, but the Tier-1/Tier-2 social tier was unverified, so the quiet verdict is unconfirmed. Guard added to PROMPT.md step 5 as a result; has held on every subsequent reviewed run (10-14, 10-15, 10-28, 10-29 all scanned the full X tier).

notes: A 'quiet day' declared without scanning the playwright-x timelines is SUSPECT, not confirmed quiet. PROMPT.md step 5 carries an explicit guard forbidding a quiet declaration until all tiers incl. playwright-x are fetched. Guard has held on every reviewed run since 10-13 (10-14, 10-15, 10-28, 10-29). Keep the guard.

VENDOR LAUNCHES SURFACE ON X BEFORE/INSTEAD OF THE BLOG — now confirmed across THREE vendors, not just DeepMind: Gemini 4 Carbon (10-29) and Genie 4 (10-28) via @GoogleDeepMind, the Sleep framework via @GoogleResearch (10-29), and the Mistral Responses API via @MistralAI (10-29) all arrived on the handle while the first-party blog/news page was quiet or lagging. The playwright-x vendor tier is the pipeline's single most productive source class. Keep prioritizing the handles as primary launch signals; treat the blog as corroboration, not the trigger.

VERIFY-BEFORE-TOPPING held up: 2026-10-29's #1 item (Gemini 4 Carbon, score 5) rested solely on a logged-out @GoogleDeepMind timeline screenshot. Meta-agent independently confirmed it against @GoogleDeepMind's own post (From blog.google link), MarkTechPost, Geeky Gadgets, There'sAnAIForThat and Digg — facts matched (AA Index v5.0 score 59 rank #1, SEC-bench Pro 88.2%, successor to Argon ~2 weeks prior). Calibration was correct; score 5 justified. Lesson stands: an X-only frontier-model claim should get a primary cross-check before it tops the report, and on 10-29 the pipeline's output was consistent with one.

Harness²-type gap (research launched via arXiv+GitHub only) — the 10-28 fix (@GoogleResearch added to playwright-x) is VALIDATED: on its very first scan (10-29) it delivered the Sleep-framework item. Still-open idea (recorded, not yet implemented; a new source TYPE beyond the 2-change budget): an arXiv cs.AI 'agent/harness' watch with a 72h lookback, since papers surface days after submission and remain the one uncovered path.

Edge-of-window discipline continues to hold: on 10-29 the run correctly EXCLUDED GPT-6.1 Terra (OpenAI, Oct 26-27) and Anthropic's S-1 (Oct 26) as just-outside-window, while KEEPING the Sleep framework on its Oct 28 @GoogleResearch announcement despite the Oct 27 blog dateline. Good handling of the announcement-date-vs-publish-date distinction — anchor to the in-window first-party signal.
